title: Magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- glass lens lens fill -->
    <circle cx="42" cy="38" r="24" fill="#49C6FF" opacity="0.55"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="38" r="24" fill="none" stroke="#9FE8FF" stroke-width="7"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="38" r="24" fill="none" stroke="#2B7FD4" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5"/>
    <!-- lens shine -->
    <path d="M30 26 Q34 20 42 19" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.9"/>
    <!-- sparkle inside lens -->
    <circle cx="52" cy="46" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
    <!-- handle connector -->
    <rect x="58" y="54" width="12" height="10" rx="3" fill="#FFB13D" transform="rotate(45 64 59)"/>
    <!-- handle -->
    <rect x="63" y="60" width="13" height="30" rx="6.5" fill="#FF8A3D" transform="rotate(45 69 75)"/>
    <!-- handle highlight -->
    <rect x="65" y="63" width="4" height="24" rx="2" fill="#FFC98A" transform="rotate(45 67 75)" opacity="0.9"/>
  </g>
</svg>
